questions.question:
Write the “Poetry Analysis Response” for the poem you just read (“Ozymandias,” by Percy Bysshe Shelley).
You may use ONE body paragraph:
Hints:
Subject:
A ruined statue of a once-powerful king.
Most prominent poetic devices:
Irony:
The inscription "Look on my Works, ye Mighty, and despair!" is followed immediately by "Nothing beside remains"
Imagery:
"Half sunk a shattered visage lies, whose frown, / And wrinkled lip, and sneer of cold command"
These lines build the broken face detail by detail
Theme(s):
Human power and pride are temporary, and time erases even what was built specifically to outlast it.
Word Limit:
Introduction – 60-70 words
Body paragraph – 80-90 words
Conclusion – 50-60 words
OR
Write an advice sheet on the following topic:
“Advising your peers on how to follow a healthy eating habit”
You may use ONLY TWO body paragraphs.
Word Limit:
  • Introduction – 60–70 words
  • Body paragraphs – 80–90 words
  • Conclusion – 50–60 words
